environment.description: ECS Fargate service running behind an Application Load Balancer with no rate limiting. PostgreSQL RDS instance with no UNIQUE constraint on the redemptions table. Kafka cluster with default configuration allowing duplicate message delivery. The /api/v1/redeem endpoint is publicly accessible. No request deduplication at any layer.

config.infrastructure: AWS ECS Fargate + ALB + MSK + RDS PostgreSQL
config.alb_config: default listener rules, no WAF attached
config.db_schema: CREATE TABLE redemptions (id SERIAL, user_id TEXT, coupon_code TEXT, amount NUMERIC, request_id TEXT, redeemed_at TIMESTAMP)
config.network: ALB public-facing, security group allows 0.0.0.0/0 on port 443
